title: Tyr's Hand Abbey

[[Image:Tyr's Hand Abbey.jpg|thumb|Tyr's Hand Abbey]]
'''Tyr's Hand Abbey''' is the smaller of the two religious facilities at [[Tyr's Hand]], the larger being [[the Scarlet Basilica]]. The abbey is well tended for, and has different function for the religious [[Scarlet Crusade]] than the basilica does. It is built very much like [[Northshire Abbey]].
